text: This report recommends that the name “Acapella Lane” be approved to identify an existing public lane located south of Dupont Street, extending east of Manning Avenue. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/ .
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Acapella Lane" for an existing public lane located south of Dupont Street, extending east of Manning Avenue.
